question_pt: Qual foi o mix percentual de carater de internacao por ano?
next_action: Comparar valores e revisar metrica, filtros, data ou geografia.
generated_sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    year(i.DT_INTER) AS ano,
    i.CAR_INT AS carater,
    COUNT(*) AS internacoes
  FROM internacoes i
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), total AS (
  SELECT
    ano,
    SUM(internacoes) AS total_ano
  FROM base
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  b.ano,
  b.carater,
  b.internacoes,
  ROUND(100.0 * b.internacoes / t.total_ano, 4) AS percentual_ano
FROM base b
JOIN total t ON b.ano = t.ano
ORDER BY b.ano, percentual_ano DESC, b.carater
